entities.name: voltage-gated sodium currents in DRG neurons

relationships.subject: SARS-CoV-2 spike protein
relationships.evidence_quote: An interaction between spike (S1 domain aa 16-685, containing the CendR motif 682RRAR685) and the extracellular portion of NRP-1 was confirmed by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (Fig. 1A).

relationships.subject: VEGF-A
relationships.evidence_quote: Vascular endothelial growth factor-A increased spontaneous firing of DRG neurons, which was blocked by the S1 domain of the spike protein and by the NRP-1 inhibitor EG00229 (Fig. 1A).

relationships.subject: SARS-CoV-2 spike protein
relationships.evidence_quote: Our data show that SARS-CoV-2 spike protein subverts VEGF-A/NRP-1 pronociceptive signaling.

relationships.subject: VEGF-A
relationships.object: voltage-gated sodium currents in DRG neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Vascular endothelial growth factor-A facilitated a 1.9-fold increase in total Na+ currents compared to vehicle (PBS)-treated DRG, which was completely blocked by spike protein (Figs. 3B and C).

relationships.subject: VEGF-A
relationships.evidence_quote: Vascular endothelial growth factor-A facilitated a 1.8-fold increase in total Ca2+ currents compared to vehicle (PBS)-treated DRG, which was completely blocked by spike protein (Figs. 4A–C and Table S1, http://links.lww.com/PAIN/B190).

relationships.subject: EG00229
relationships.evidence_quote: Finally, inhibition of NRP-1 signaling with EG00229 also reversed paw withdrawal thresholds (Figs. 6G and H and Table S1, http://links.lww.com/PAIN/B190).

relationships.subject: SARS-CoV-2 spike protein
relationships.evidence_quote: In rats with SNI, intrathecal application of spike decreased the phosphorylation of VEGFR2 (Y1175) on both the contralateral (noninjured) and ipsilateral (injured) sides (Figs. 6A and B).

key_findings: Spike protein blocks VEGF-A/NRP-1 signaling, reducing DRG neuron firing, Na+ and Cav2.2 currents, spinal sEPSC frequency and pain behaviors.
Spike or EG00229 reversed mechanical allodynia in rat spared nerve injury.
